entries.title: Job 30:1
segments: ¶But now [they that are] younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock. {younger...: Heb. of fewer days than I}

words.text: than I have me in derision
. {younger...: Heb. of fewer days than I}

entries.title: Job 30:2
segments: Yea, whereto [might] the strength of their hands [profit] me, in whom old age was perished?

entries.title: Job 30:3
segments: For want and famine [they were] solitary; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste. {solitary: or, dark as the night} {in...: Heb. yesternight}

words.text: . {solitary: or, dark as the night} {in...: Heb. yesternight}

entries.title: Job 30:4
segments: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots [for] their meat.

entries.title: Job 30:5
segments: They were driven forth from among [men], (they cried after them as [after] a thief;)

entries.title: Job 30:6
segments: To dwell in the clifts of the valleys, [in] caves of the earth, and [in] the rocks. {caves: Heb. holes}

entries.title: Job 30:7
segments: Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.

entries.title: Job 30:8
segments: [They were] children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than the earth. {base...: Heb. men of no name}

entries.title: Job 30:9
segments: And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.

words.text: And now am I their song

entries.title: Job 30:10
segments: They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face. {and...: Heb. and withhold not spittle from}

words.text: . {and...: Heb. and withhold not spittle from}

entries.title: Job 30:11
segments: Because he hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before me.

words.text: me, they have also let loose

entries.title: Job 30:12
segments: Upon [my] right [hand] rise the youth; they push away my feet, and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.

entries.title: Job 30:13
segments: They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.

entries.title: Job 30:14
segments: They came [upon me] as a wide breaking in [of waters]: in the desolation they rolled themselves [upon me].

entries.title: Job 30:15
segments: ¶Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and my welfare passeth away as a cloud. {my soul: Heb. my principal one}

entries.title: Job 30:16
segments: And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me.

entries.title: Job 30:17
segments: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.

words.text: in me in the night season

entries.title: Job 30:18
segments: By the great force [of my disease] is my garment changed: it bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.

entries.title: Job 30:19
segments: He hath cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and ashes.

entries.title: Job 30:20
segments: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not hear me: I stand up, and thou regardest me [not].

words.text: unto thee, and thou dost not hear

entries.title: Job 30:21
segments: Thou art become cruel to me: with thy strong hand thou opposest thyself against me. {become...: Heb. turned to be cruel} {thy...: Heb. the strength of thy hand}

words.text: thyself against me. {become...: Heb. turned to be cruel} {thy...: Heb. the strength of thy hand}

entries.title: Job 30:22
segments: Thou liftest me up to the wind; thou causest me to ride [upon it], and dissolvest my substance. {substance: or, wisdom}

entries.title: Job 30:23
segments: For I know [that] thou wilt bring me [to] death, and [to] the house appointed for all living.

entries.title: Job 30:24
segments: Howbeit he will not stretch out [his] hand to the grave, though they cry in his destruction. {grave: Heb. heap}

words.text: Howbeit he will not stretch out

entries.title: Job 30:25
segments: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was [not] my soul grieved for the poor? {in trouble: Heb. hard of day?}

words.text: for him that was in trouble

entries.title: Job 30:26
segments: When I looked for good, then evil came [unto me]: and when I waited for light, there came darkness.

entries.title: Job 30:27
segments: My bowels boiled, and rested not: the days of affliction prevented me.

entries.title: Job 30:28
segments: I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, [and] I cried in the congregation.

entries.title: Job 30:29
segments: I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls. {owls: or, ostriches}

entries.title: Job 30:30
segments: My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.

entries.title: Job 30:31
segments: My harp also is [turned] to mourning, and my organ into the voice of them that weep.
